body: المدرب الهولندي يكشف شعوره لدى مشاهدة ابنه روبن فان بوميل مع منتخب "الطواحين" كما يكيل المديح للمدرب الفرنسي زين الدين زيدان قبل مواجهتهما في دوري الأمم الأوروبية.

title: هرمز واليمن: تهدئة إيرانية معروضة بثمن يدفعه الآخرون
body: يرى المقال أن عرض إيران فتح هرمز مقابل رفع العقوبات والإفراج عن أموالها قد يكرس تحكمها بالملاحة، ويحذر من ربط الصفقة باليمن بما يهدد هرمز وباب المندب معا.

title: ماذا قال مدرب إسبانيا عن انفرادات توريس الضائعة أمام إنجلترا؟
body: أهدر فيران توريس فرصتين ثمينتين أمام إنجلترا، في مباراة شهدت تألق إسبانيا، وسط انتقادات للمهاجم الإسباني، فيما يخرج مدربه بتصريحات لافتة للدفاع عنه.

title: "سنزلزل السجون".. غالانت يتهم الشاباك بالإخفاق في تفسير "رسالة من حماس"
body: كشف وزير الدفاع الإسرائيلي السابق يوآف غالانت عن رسالة غير مباشرة وصلت من حماس قبل 7 أكتوبر تحدثت عن "زلزال" في ملف الأسرى، أخفقت الاستخبارات في تفسيرها بربطها خطأ بقضية باحثة إسرائيلية مختطفة.

title: أوروبا تعول على الغاز النرويجي في ظل منافسة حادة من آسيا

title: كيف تفاعل الشارع الأمريكي مع إغلاق 250 متجرا لستاربكس؟
body: تخطط ستاربكس لإغلاق 250 متجرا بأمريكا الشمالية لتخفيض النفقات. القرار أثار جدلا واسعا، فبينما برره البعض كضرورة اقتصادية لإنقاذ الشركة، انتقده آخرون واعتبروه تهربا من دفع أجور عادلة للعمال.

title: لماذا لا يُسمع الصوت الإيراني في الساحة الدولية؟

title: از پایگاه هوایی فرفورد بریتانیا چه می‌دانیم؟
body: پایگاه نیروی هوایی سلطنتی فرفورد در گلاسترشر انگلستان متعلق به بریتانیاست و نیروی هوایی آمریکا هم برای عملیات از آن استفاده می‌کند. به گفته وزارت دفاع بریتانیا، نیروی هوایی آمریکا از فرفورد به‌عنوان پایگاه عملیاتی بمب‌افکن‌های پبشاهنگ استفاده می‌کند. بر اساس اطلاعات رسمی نیروی هوایی آمریکا، پایگاه فرفورد محل استقرار بمب‌افکن‌های پیشاهنگ در اروپا است.

title: Sheikh Qassem says Palestine remains Hezbollah’s compass, vows to continue resistance

title: Iran hails Martyr Nasrallah as unique model of courage, foresight in confronting occupation

title: Parliamentary commission completes review of Hormuz Strait security bill
body: Tehran, IRNA – The Parliament’s National Security and Foreign Policy Commission has completed its review of a strategic bill aimed at securing the Strait of Hormuz and ensuring sustainable development in the waterway and the Persian Gulf, the commission’s spokesperson said on Sunday.

title: Reopening of Strait of Hormuz depends on US fulfillment of Iran’s conditions: Araghchi
body: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, referring to Iran's conditions recently conveyed to the United States in indirect messages through mediators, says Tehran is prepared to reopen the Strait of Hormuz provided Washington takes specific actions.

title: Iran thwarted enemy’s naval blockade calculations, says Judiciary chief
body: Tehran, IRNA – Judiciary Chief Gholamhossein Mohseni-Ejei says the enemy had assumed that a naval blockade would prevent essential goods from reaching Iran, but Iran thwarted the calculation and took the initiative.

title: Leader’s aide highlights strategic role of Iranian oil industry in nation’s power equation
body: Tehran, IRNA – A senior military advisor to the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, says Iran's power equation is determined not only in the public arena, but also in the energy sector, emphasizing that the oil industry constitutes a part of national strength and security.

The main message of the developments and speeches in New York can be summarized in one key proposition: the era of unipolar order and cost-free bullying has come to an end. Iran does not welcome war, but it will not compromise when it comes to defending its dignity and independence.

title: Saudi warplanes bomb Yemeni marketplace, killing and wounding civilians
body: TEHRAN — Saudi fighter jets bombed a crowded civilian marketplace in southwestern Yemen on Sunday morning. According to preliminary reports, the attack killed at least seven people and wounded at least 43 others. Several children were among the casualties.

title: Army: Iran will deliver a more crushing response to renewed US aggression
body: TEHRAN – The spokesman for Iran’s Army has warned enemies against any further miscalculations, stating that the country’s Armed Forces are fully prepared to deliver a “more crushing” response in the event of renewed aggression.

title: Army chief: Driving US and Israel out of West Asia prerequisite for lasting security
body: TEHRAN — Commander-in-Chief of the Iranian Army Major General Amir Hatami said on Sunday that lasting security in West Asia requires an end to the military and political presence of the United States and Israel, stressing that collective regional stability can only be built from within rather than dictated by extra-regional powers.

title: Iran fires on vessels traversing unauthorized routes in Strait of Hormuz
body: TEHRAN – Iranian naval forces have fired warning shots at several foreign vessels attempting to breach designated maritime transit lanes in the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz.

title: Pezeshkian: Iran,US have reached a framework for possible negotiations
body: TEHRAN— Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has said that differences surrounding the Strait of Hormuz can be resolved through dialogue and regional cooperation, stressing that Iran will not submit to pressure or threats while remaining committed to peaceful engagement with neighboring countries.

title: Iran urges UN to examine European role in US military operations against Iran
body: TEHRAN— Iran has called on the United Nations Security Council to examine the role played by European territory, military bases and infrastructure in supporting US military operations against the Islamic Republic, arguing that such assistance could raise questions of international responsibility for the states and officials involved.

title: Another catch in Hormuz
body: TEHRAN — In another humiliating blow to the US automated naval warfare doctrine, the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy has intercepted and captured a state-of-the-art American autonomous underwater vehicle in the Strait of Hormuz, further cementing Iran’s control over the world’s most vital energy chokepoint.

title: Araghchi: Iran will stand firm against any aggression, even a 'Doomsday War'
body: TEHRAN— Iran has used an intensive diplomatic campaign on the sidelines of the 81st United Nations General Assembly to reiterate that it remains open to diplomacy, while insisting that any future negotiations with the United States must be based on reciprocal commitments, respect for Iran’s rights and guarantees against a repetition of previous breaches of agreements.

title: Iran will respond to any aggression with new weapons
body: TEHRAN — Iran has warned the United States against any intervention in the Strait of Hormuz, while stressing that its Armed Forces have developed new military technologies and capabilities to respond to any potential aggression.

title: 5 arrested near British air base used by US over alleged bomb plot
body: British authorities evacuated several homes on Sunday over fears of explosive ordnance near RAF Fairford, an air force base in southern England. American military personnel are stationed at the base, and the United States has used it in recent months to load B-52 and B-1 bombers before sending them to strike sites in Iran.

title: Trump is first and foremost a 'fabulist'
body: TEHRAN - Daniel Dale, a former Washington correspondent for the Toronto Star wrote an analysis casting light on Donald Trump’s lies, calling him a “fabulist”.

title: Iranian runner Zahra Zarei aims to compete at Olympics
body: TEHRAN - Iranian national team female athlete Zahra Zarei says her goal is to compete at the Olympics.
